> Prepare and verify a release

1. Follow docs/RELEASES.md.
2. Let Release Please own versions, changelog, release PR, and tag.
3. Run complete validation and a GoReleaser snapshot.
4. Verify six archives, checksums, SBOMs, allowlist, and version output.
5. Stop before publication unless explicitly authorized.
